title: Importance of Entities in Knowledge
title_en: Importance of Entities in Knowledge
title_zh: 知识中实体的重要性
venue: IEEE/WIC/ACM International Conference on Web Intelligence
abstract_en: There is a growing need for managing importance of entities in knowledge system in order to realize the full potential of knowledge. How to calculate the importance of entities automatically is the primary issue. We argue that importance of entities in knowledge is dynamic, the importance is changed along with the using of ontology; and different groups of user have different criteria of importance. In this paper, a novel weight assignment method which takes usage and structure properties of ontology into account is proposed. When considering the usage information of ontology, we analyze paths that are used to respond to queries; and use the frequency of entities included in the paths to produce the optimal weight assignment for the assumption of high importance of entities which included in paths that respond to queries. After get the initial weight of entities, a pervasion algorithm which considers the structure of ontology is used to compute the final weight of entities. Weight of a node is high if the node has many incoming links and the incoming links and nodes which these links are from have high scores. Experiment show effectiveness of this weight assignment method.
abstract_zh: 为了充分发挥知识的潜力，越来越需要管理知识系统中实体的重要性。如何自动计算实体的重要性是首要问题。我们认为知识中实体的重要性是动态的，其重要性随着本体论的使用而变化；不同的用户群体有不同的重要性标准。本文提出了一种考虑本体的使用和结构特性的新型权重分配方法。在考虑本体的使用信息时，我们分析用于响应查询的路径；并使用路径中包含的实体的频率来为假设生成最佳权重分配......

title: Adaptive Template Filtering Method for MRI
title_en: Adaptive Template Filtering Method for MRI
title_zh: MRI自适应模板过滤方法
abstract_en: Denoising is an important step for image processing. One of the most important characteristics of MRI (MRI) is the complicated changes of gray level. For MRI, preservation of useful information is more important than simple improvement of Signal-Noise Ratio (SNR). Traditional filtering algorithms are not fit for MRI. Adaptive Template Filtering Method (ATFM) can dynamically match the best template from the predetermined multi templates based on local texture characteristics for each pixel. In this paper, detail algorithm and analysis are given. Compared with other filtering methods, the performance of ATFM is better than that of other filtering methods as our experiment demonstrates. It can both effectively suppresses noise and best preserve useful information at the same time for MRI. Thus, ATFM can meet the need of clinical diagnosis and image processing.

title: Research on Medical Diagnosis Decision Support System for Acid-base Disturbance Based on Support Vector Machine
title_en: Research on Medical Diagnosis Decision Support System for Acid-base Disturbance Based on Support Vector Machine
title_zh: 基于支持向量机的酸碱紊乱医疗诊断决策支持系统研究
venue: Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC)
abstract_en: Support Vector Machine (SVM) is a new learning technique based on Statistical Learning Theory (SLT). In this paper, a Medical Diagnosis Decision System (MDDSS) based on SVM has been established to intellectively diagnose 4 types of acid-base disturbance. SVM was originally developed for two-class classification. It is extended to solve multi-class classification problem named hierarchical SVM with clustering algorithm based on stepwise decomposition. Compared with other classical classification techniques, SVM not only has more solid theoretical foundation, it also has greater generalization ability as our experiment demonstrates. Thus, SVM exhibits its great potential in MDDSS.
abstract_zh: 支持向量机（SVM）是一种基于统计学习理论（SLT）的新型学习技术。本文建立了基于SVM的医学诊断决策系统（MDDSS），用于智能诊断4种酸碱紊乱。 SVM 最初是为二类分类而开发的。它被扩展到用基于逐步分解的聚类算法来解决多类分类问题，称为层次SVM。与其他经典分类技术相比，SVM不仅具有更扎实的理论基础，而且正如我们的实验表明的那样，它还具有更强的泛化能力。因此，SVM在MDDSS中展现出了其巨大的潜力。

title: Construction Method of a New Type Semantic Network for Image Retrieval
title_en: Construction Method of a New Type Semantic Network for Image Retrieval
title_zh: 一种新型图像检索语义网络的构建方法
abstract_en: Self-learning semantic network is now a resultful method of achieving high-level image semanteme. For remedying the shortcomings of the existing methods, this paper proposes the construction method of a new type semantic network for the image retrieval. The method supports the image retrieval by combining the three techniques: low-level feature, relevant feedback, and semantic network. The experiment results proved that this method can enhance the system's retrieval efficiency.
abstract_zh: 自学习语义网络现在是实现高级图像语义的有效方法。针对现有方法的不足，提出一种新型图像检索语义网络的构建方法。该方法通过结合低级特征、相关反馈和语义网络三种技术来支持图像检索。实验结果证明该方法能够提高系统的检索效率。

title: A new method of conceptual design based on the theory of fuzzy sets pattern recognition and its application in the electrical apparatus design expert system
title_en: A new method of conceptual design based on the theory of fuzzy sets pattern recognition and its application in the electrical apparatus design expert system
title_zh: 基于模糊集模式识别理论的概念设计新方法及其在电器设计专家系统中的应用
venue: World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract_en: A method for conceptual design of mechanical products was proposed based on the fuzzy closeness degree in the theory of fuzzy sets pattern recognition: at first, the fuzzy sets of the characteristic factors of each kind of available products and those of the products designed in terms of the fuzzy description of the users' requirements. Secondly, the similarity degree between the products designed and every kind of available products were gotten by calculating the fuzzy closeness degree between fuzzy sets and synthesizing the weight of the characteristic factors. Finally, a certain type of product was selected according to the greatest- similarity degree criterion, thus the conceptual design of the product was fulfilled. It also presents a method of distributing weight to characteristic factors according to the mean square-root among classes. The methods was applied to the electrical apparatus expert system designing-oriented.

title: World-centered representation for neural networks
title_en: World-centered representation for neural networks
title_zh: 神经网络的以世界为中心的表示
venue: IEEE International Conference on Neural Networks/IEEE ... International Conference on Neural Networks
abstract_en: A basic problem for pattern recognition is invariance. This article argues that the traditional full-parallel computation of neural networks that has excluded many useful series computation methods seems improper for the invariance. We introduce a series search mechanism into neural computing. The world-centered recognition is acquired by a pattern-centered memory plus a space search.
abstract_zh: 模式识别的一个基本问题是不变性。本文认为，传统的神经网络全并行计算排除了许多有用的串行计算方法，这似乎不适合不变性。我们将一系列搜索机制引入神经计算中。以世界为中心的识别是通过以模式为中心的记忆加上空间搜索来获得的。
